result.summary: The image shows a wide urban street with multi-story mixed-use buildings and signalized traffic control. However, there is a notable lack of pedestrian-specific infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals at the visible intersection, creating a high-exposure environment.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, making pedestrian movements unpredictable for drivers at a signalized junction.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles close to the intersection corners may block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right and left curbsides near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic signal infrastructure to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection features marked crosswalks and curb ramps but is significantly compromised by a large truck parked near the corner, which creates a major visual obstruction. The pedestrian environment is primarily commercial with wide sidewalks, though the pavement markings are somewhat faded and lack modern safety enhancements like bulb-outs.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Truck
hazards.description: A large box truck is parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, completely blocking the sightlines between pedestrians entering the street and approaching vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground, parked along the curb near the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn and faded, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and physically prevent vehicles from parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Repainting
interventions.description: Refresh the crosswalk markings using high-durability thermoplastic material to improve visibility.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure is present, the long crossing distance across multiple lanes without a median refuge increases pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a mid-point refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Wide Lane Widths
hazards.description: The wide, open road geometry can encourage higher vehicle speeds through the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians and shorten the unprotected crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban intersection with multi-lane traffic and significant crossing distances for pedestrians. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks, signals, and marked crosswalks are present, the lack of mid-crossing refuge and the scale of the roadway increase pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the main roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for an extended period without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main multi-lane road

hazards.name: Turning Vehicle Conflict
hazards.description: Vehicles turning from the side street onto the main road may conflict with pedestrians using the marked crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection where the grey car is positioned

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.
